name: ttb-label-reviewer-root
description: Root helper scripts for the local-first TTB Label Reviewer assessment project.

scripts.test:js: npm run browser:test && npm run console:test
scripts.test: npm --prefix browser-demo test && npm --prefix apps/console test
scripts.build: npm --prefix browser-demo run build && npm --prefix apps/console run build
scripts.playwright:install: npm --prefix browser-demo exec playwright install chromium && npm --prefix apps/console exec playwright install chromium
